name: n8n sign-in flow
_comment: Template multi-step flow for webcheck run. Usage: make webcheck FLOW=scripts/webcheck/n8n-signin.json  (start n8n first). IMPORTANT: selectors below are best-effort guesses for n8n editor-ui (1.x) and are UNVERIFIED against a real n8n instance (none is running in this environment). Comma lists only work when the alternatives target the SAME element - Playwright strict mode throws if they match different elements (e.g. a data-test-id wrapper + an inner input). Run with --headed and adjust selectors to your n8n version before relying on this.

steps._comment: n8n is a Vue SPA - wait for the app shell before asserting
wait_for tolerates multiple matches; fill/click do NOT (strict mode)
Pick ONE selector that resolves to the real input on your version
data-test-id on the submit button varies by version; text match is the stable fallback but only if it does not also match other elements
After sign-in n8n lands on the Workflows list; wait for a stable element
